divergences.behaviour: An API key with no grants can reach everything
divergences.reason: fail-open does not belong in a multi-tenant platform; a key reaches only what it is granted, and the legacy flag that kept the old default is removed

divergences.behaviour: skills.* settings work in the playground and REST, not MCP and /v1
divergences.reason: every setting works on every entry point, so the old MCP and /v1 results are not the reference
the new platform follows the current MCP revision, which removes ping

divergences.behaviour: Debug routes behind a shared key
divergences.reason: operator diagnostics sit behind operator roles, so a shared key is refused

divergences.behaviour: Agent guardrails are stored but not enforced
divergences.reason: guardrails are enforced or not offered, so the old unguarded answers are not the reference

divergences.behaviour: MCP accepts request bodies of any size
divergences.reason: input is bounded; bodies over 1 MiB are refused

divergences.behaviour: /v1 streaming sends the whole answer as one delta, citations first
divergences.reason: by default the whole answer still comes as one delta; a client that asks for live streaming gets token deltas, retract frames and citations after the text, so frame order is not compared

divergences.behaviour: No timeouts on Typesense and ColBERT calls
divergences.reason: every outbound call has a timeout so a hung dependency cannot hang a request

divergences.behaviour: /api/facets on a field the dataset does not declare answers 502 or empty
divergences.reason: a field the dataset does not declare is the caller's error, so it is refused with 400

divergences.behaviour: A model argument on a tool call overrides the agent's model
divergences.reason: the service definition decides the model, checked for residency at publish, so a per-call model is accepted and ignored

divergences.behaviour: An answer cites [N] per chunk of the synthesis context, renumbered after streaming
divergences.reason: KA numbers its sources per document in the order structuredContent.chunks lists them, so the new platform numbers the synthesis context per document in that order and keeps the streamed numbers

divergences.behaviour: Chunk text in structuredContent keeps the source's {N} page markers
divergences.reason: page markers are layout residue from PDF conversion that clients show as text, so published chunk text leaves them out

divergences.behaviour: The conversation routes answer 400 "Missing X-User-Id header" to an API key without X-User-Id
divergences.reason: only a key bound to a service serves end users and may name one with X-User-Id; any other key, or a bound key without the header, owns its conversations itself

divergences.behaviour: MCP refuses initialize with -32022 and accepts only the 2026-07-28 revision
divergences.reason: the platform negotiates a common MCP version per the spec: initialize is answered with a supported handshake version, so older tool servers and the platform's own client can connect
